network: Separate server/client processes on clean IPv4 loopback, transparent counting proxy in client process; no artificial bandwidth/latency/loss.
counters: Successfully forwarded TCP stream bytes / UDP datagram bytes, both directions exactly once; includes handshake, dictionary updates/ACKs, application receipts and reliable transport controls/retries; excludes IP/transport/link headers and final harness shutdown message.
phases: See per-workload phasePlans. Standard workloads use cold 64, warm 128, stop-and-wait latency 64. adaptive-32k uses fresh random 64, repeated 64, fresh random churn 64, return of original 64, byte runs 64, stop-and-wait byte-runs latency 64; one cache persists across phases. spaced-32k repeats a cycle of 32 independently seeded random objects across cold 64, warm 128 (which may still include dictionary growth), trained bulk 64, and stop-and-wait latency 64. marginal-32k uses fresh random objects with 512 stable high-entropy bytes around the 4/9 scout position (1.6% stable) and standard phases. Bulk RTT uses window 8. Byte snapshots include trailing controls after 160 ms quiet and a reliable-UDP server queue-drain barrier (included in bytes); settling is excluded from throughput timers. Setup timing is Connect only; setup byte counts include its quiet drain.
settings: SafeMode/compatibility negotiation on; only BinarySerializer.EnableCompression changes; outer compression, old pattern cache, P2P, batching, FPS and bandwidth caps off. Reliable UDP default Adaptive, independent delivery, 1200-byte datagrams.
cpu: cpuMs is client-process CPU, including counting proxy, not combined endpoint CPU. allocatedBytes is approximate process-wide managed allocation during the timed phase, including the proxy; counters are read outside the stopwatch and exclude the later drain.
